Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning insurance for enlisted members of the Washington national guard.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to insurance for enlisted members of the Washingtonnational guard; and adding a new section to chapter 38.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 38.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All enlisted members of grade E1 through E5 of the Washingtonnational guard who enlist after August 1, 2014, for a minimum period ofthree years, are eligible for additional compensation from the state ofWashington in the form of a payment of the monthly premium for theeligible member for a qualified premiumbased health plan and premiumbased dental plan provided for active duty service members, nationalguard and reserve members, and other eligible persons. The state ofWashington shall select the qualified premiumbased plans that applypursuant to this section. (2) The compensation described in subsection (1) of this sectionmust be paid for the period of the enlistment.
